$comment: scripts/collect-third-party-licenses.mjs reads this file. Each entry names a package that has no license file and no license expression with a standard text in scripts/license-texts/. Each entry must give the reason that the installers can ship the package without its license text. The collector fails for an entry that no longer matches such a package. Entry shape: { "ecosystem": "cargo" or "npm", "name": "...", "version": "...", "reason": "..." }.
